custom-backpack-suitcase-walk-main: She walks slowly and upright, carrying a closed dark-grey backpack by its top handle in her right hand at her side like a suitcase, left arm relaxed, shoulders level, mid-stride. Side three-quarter view.
custom-band-high-pulldown-start: She stands facing a sturdy door frame; a light-blue resistance band is looped securely over a high anchor above her head. Both arms are raised overhead holding the band ends, elbows nearly straight. Three-quarter back-side view so the band and arms are clear.
custom-band-high-pulldown-peak: Same setup with the light-blue band anchored high on the door frame; she has PULLED THE BAND DOWN: both elbows are bent and drawn down close to her ribs, hands at shoulder height, upper arms by her sides, band stretched from the anchor down to her hands. Three-quarter back-side view.
custom-band-self-anchored-row-start: She sits upright on the floor on a grey exercise mat, legs extended forward with knees slightly bent; a light-blue resistance band loops around the middle of both feet and she holds its ends with arms extended forward. Side view.
custom-band-self-anchored-row-peak: Same seated position on the mat with the light-blue band around her feet; she has drawn both elbows back past her torso, squeezing shoulder blades, torso upright and still. Side view.
custom-bottle-farmer-walk-main: She walks slowly and upright holding a sealed clear water bottle in each hand, arms hanging straight by her sides, mid-stride. Side three-quarter view.
custom-chair-sit-to-stand-peak: Standing fully upright in front of the same simple light-wood chair (behind her), arms reaching forward at shoulder height, feet hip-width apart, just after standing up. Side three-quarter view.
custom-forearm-ground-step-start: Forearm plank on a grey exercise mat: supported on both forearms and toes, feet slightly apart, body in a straight line from head to heels. Side view.
custom-forearm-ground-step-peak: Forearm plank on a grey mat, clearly mid-step: her right forearm is placed noticeably ahead of the left forearm (about a hand length), and her left foot is lifted slightly and stepping forward, torso level. Side view.
custom-forearm-wall-push-start: Standing facing a plain wall, feet a small step back, leaning in so her body is a straight slight diagonal. IMPORTANT: her FOREARMS (the whole lower arm from elbow to wrist) lie flat against the wall, elbows bent about 90 degrees, hands relaxed or loosely fisted; palms are NOT pressing the wall. Side view.
custom-forearm-wall-push-peak: Facing a plain wall, she has pushed back to a more upright position, body straight. IMPORTANT: her FOREARMS (the whole lower arm from elbow to wrist) lie flat against the wall, elbows bent about 90 degrees, hands relaxed or loosely fisted; palms are NOT pressing the wall. Side view.
custom-high-wall-sit-start: Standing with her back flat against a plain wall, feet stepped forward about one foot length, legs straight, arms relaxed by her sides. Side view.
custom-high-wall-sit-peak: Back flat against a plain wall in a shallow wall sit: knees bent only about 30 to 45 degrees (high position, not 90), feet forward, hands resting on thighs. Side view.
custom-kneeling-forearm-crawl-start: On all fours on a grey exercise mat, supported on both forearms and knees, hands relaxed, back flat. Side view.
custom-kneeling-forearm-crawl-peak: On forearms and knees on a grey mat, mid-crawl: right forearm and left knee moved a short step forward, back flat and steady. Side view.
custom-kneeling-knuckle-push-up-start: Kneeling push-up top position on a grey exercise mat: knees down, ankles crossed behind, arms straight with gently closed fists on the mat, wrists straight, body straight from head to knees. Side view.
custom-kneeling-knuckle-push-up-peak: Kneeling push-up lowered position on a grey mat: knees down, elbows bent, chest lowered toward the mat on closed fists, body straight from head to knees. Side view.
custom-kneeling-side-bridge-start: Lying on her left side on a grey exercise mat, propped on her left forearm under the shoulder, knees bent at 90 degrees behind her, hips resting on the mat. Front view.
custom-kneeling-side-bridge-peak: Kneeling side plank on a grey mat: propped on left forearm and bent knees, hips lifted so shoulder, hip and knee are in a straight line, right hand on hip. Front view.
custom-quiet-march-start: Standing tall with feet together, arms relaxed and starting a natural swing. Front three-quarter view.
custom-quiet-march-peak: Marching in place quietly: right knee gently lifted to about hip-low height, foot just off the floor, opposite arm swinging forward naturally. Front three-quarter view.
custom-quiet-shadow-boxing-start: Relaxed boxing stance with no gloves: feet slightly wider than hips, knees soft, both fists loosely near the chest. Front three-quarter view.
custom-quiet-shadow-boxing-peak: Gentle shadow boxing: right arm extended in a soft forward punch with elbow not locked, left fist guarding near the chest, feet planted. Front three-quarter view.
custom-seated-march-start: Sitting upright on a simple light-wood chair, both feet flat on the floor, hands resting lightly on the sides of the seat. Side three-quarter view.
custom-seated-march-peak: Sitting upright on the same light-wood chair, right knee lifted a few inches so the foot is off the floor, hands on the sides of the seat. Side three-quarter view.
custom-seated-self-overhead-press-start: Sitting cross-legged on a grey exercise mat, back upright; right hand beside the right shoulder palm up, left hand lightly pressing on top of the right forearm. Front three-quarter view.
custom-seated-self-overhead-press-peak: Sitting cross-legged on a grey mat, back upright; right arm pressed upward to a comfortable height overhead while the left hand stays lightly on the right forearm giving resistance. Front three-quarter view.
custom-seated-self-resisted-leg-curl-mai: Sitting upright on a grey exercise mat with knees bent, hands on the mat behind her for support; right ankle placed lightly in front of the left ankle, the left foot gently resisting as the right heel tries to pull back. Side view.
custom-self-resisted-chest-press-start: Standing tall facing slightly to the side; her right elbow is bent with the right fist held just in front of the middle of her chest, and her left hand wraps around her right forearm. Calm expression. Front three-quarter view.
custom-self-resisted-chest-press-peak: Standing tall; right arm extended straight forward at chest height while the left hand still holds the right forearm resisting, torso not twisted. Front three-quarter view.
custom-self-resisted-overhead-press-star: Standing tall; right hand beside the right shoulder, palm forward, left hand lightly on top of the right forearm. Front three-quarter view.
custom-self-resisted-overhead-press-peak: Standing tall; right arm pressed upward overhead to a comfortable height while the left hand stays lightly on the right forearm resisting. Front three-quarter view.
custom-self-resisted-pulldown-start: Standing tall; RIGHT ARM raised straight up overhead (elbow only slightly bent, hand open above the head), and her LEFT hand reaches up to grip the right forearm just below the elbow. Hands are NOT behind the head. Front three-quarter view.
custom-self-resisted-pulldown-peak: Standing tall; right elbow pulled down to her side at shoulder height level, left hand still holding the right forearm providing upward resistance. Front three-quarter view.
custom-self-resisted-pulldown-hold-main: Standing tall; right elbow bent and raised to about head height, left hand supporting under the right forearm, both arms tense in an isometric hold, breathing calmly. Front three-quarter view.
custom-shallow-split-squat-start: Standing in a staggered split stance: left foot forward, right foot back on the ball of the foot, legs straight, hands on hips, torso upright. Side view.
custom-shallow-split-squat-peak: Same split stance, both knees bent slightly into a shallow split squat (back knee well above the floor), hands on hips, torso upright. Side view.
custom-slow-bear-step-start: Bear plank on a grey exercise mat: hands under shoulders, toes on the mat, knees hovering a few centimetres above the floor, back flat. Side view.
custom-slow-bear-step-peak: Bear crawl on a grey mat, slow step: right hand and left foot each moved a short step forward, knees still hovering low, back flat. Side view.
custom-slow-walking-in-place-start: Standing tall, beginning a slow walk in place, arms relaxed, both feet on the floor. Front three-quarter view.
custom-slow-walking-in-place-peak: Slow walking in place, clear step: right heel lifted and right foot raised a few centimetres off the floor with the knee bent a little, weight on the left leg, arms swinging gently in opposition. Front three-quarter view.
custom-standing-cross-press-brace-main: Standing tall; both elbows bent in front of her chest, right palm pressing outward against the outside of the left forearm while the left arm resists, chest and hips facing forward. Front view.
custom-standing-heel-drag-hold-main: Standing in a staggered stance, left foot in front with heel planted and knee slightly bent, right foot behind; hands on hips, torso upright, holding still. Side view.
custom-standing-self-antileaning-main: Standing tall; palms pressed together in front of the chest at arm's length, reaching slightly forward, ribs and pelvis stacked, not leaning back. Side view.
custom-standing-self-antirotation-main: Standing tall; hands clasped together in front of her chest with elbows soft, the right hand pulling sideways while the left resists, chest facing forward. Front view.
custom-standing-self-row-start: Standing tall; right arm extended forward at waist-chest height, left hand gripping the right forearm. Front three-quarter view.
custom-standing-self-row-peak: Standing tall; right elbow drawn back beside the torso in a rowing motion, left hand still gripping the right forearm as resistance, torso not twisting. Front three-quarter view.
custom-standing-self-row-hold-main: Standing tall; right elbow bent and kept near her side, left hand holding the right wrist, both arms tense in an isometric rowing hold. Front three-quarter view.
custom-standing-side-resistance-hold-mai: Standing tall; right hand pressing outward against the outside of the right thigh, arm straight by her side, torso upright. Front view.
custom-standing-upper-back-stretch-main: Standing tall; hands linked in front at shoulder level, arms reaching forward, chin tucked and upper back gently rounded to stretch between the shoulder blades. Side three-quarter view.
custom-step-jack-start: Standing with feet together, arms relaxed by her sides. Front view.
custom-step-jack-peak: Step jack with no jump: right foot stepped out to the side, arms raised out and up to a comfortable height in a V, left foot planted. Front view.
custom-supported-heel-raise-start: Standing facing a plain wall, both hands resting lightly on the wall at chest height, feet flat. Side view.
custom-supported-heel-raise-peak: Facing a plain wall with hands lightly on it, both heels raised high onto the balls of the feet, body tall. Side view.
custom-supported-low-step-up-start: Standing in front of a low sturdy wooden step platform, right hand holding the back of a simple light-wood chair beside her for support, right foot placed on the step. Side view.
custom-supported-low-step-up-peak: Standing tall on top of the low wooden step with both feet, right hand on the back of the light-wood chair beside her for support. Side view.
custom-supported-tandem-stand-main: Standing beside a plain wall with her right hand on it, feet in a tandem stance with the left foot directly in front of the right, looking ahead, holding steady. Side three-quarter view.
custom-supported-wide-static-stand-main: Standing still in a wide stance, both feet flat on the floor, her right hand resting on the back of a simple light-wood chair beside her, looking ahead, relaxed. Front three-quarter view.
custom-wall-antirotation-press-main: Standing side-on next to a plain wall that is on her left side; her LEFT FOREARM (elbow to wrist) is pressed vertically against the wall at shoulder height, elbow bent 90 degrees, feet steady, chest facing the viewer. Palm is not on the wall. Front view.
custom-wall-plank-main: Inclined wall plank: her FOREARMS (the whole lower arm from elbow to wrist) lie flat against the wall, elbows bent about 90 degrees, hands relaxed or loosely fisted; palms are NOT pressing the wall. Forearms at shoulder height; feet stepped well back so her body forms a straight diagonal line from head to heels. Side view.
custom-wall-side-brace-main: Standing side-on next to a plain wall on her left, her whole body leaning gently sideways toward the wall in a straight line from feet to head, supported by her LEFT FOREARM resting flat against the wall at shoulder height (elbow bent, forearm vertical on the wall), feet together a little away from the wall. Front view.
custom-wall-supported-shallow-stepback-s: Standing beside a plain wall with her right hand resting on it, feet together, torso upright. Side view.
custom-wall-supported-shallow-stepback-p: Beside a plain wall with her right hand on it; left foot stepped back a short distance and both knees bent in a shallow lunge, torso upright. Side view.
custom-wall-supported-single-leg-stand-s: Standing beside a plain wall with her right hand resting on it, both feet on the floor, tall posture. Front three-quarter view.
custom-wall-supported-single-leg-stand-p: Standing beside a plain wall with her right hand on it, balancing on the right leg with the left foot lifted slightly off the floor, knee bent a little. Front three-quarter view.
custom-reverse-warrior-main: Reverse Warrior yoga pose: wide stance, front knee bent over the ankle, back leg straight; front arm reaches up and back overhead, back hand rests lightly on the back thigh, side waist long. She is barefoot on a grey yoga mat (shoes off for yoga). Front three-quarter view.
custom-goddess-pose-main: Goddess yoga pose: feet wide with toes turned out, knees bent and tracking over the toes, hips lowered to about knee height, torso upright, elbows bent at shoulder height with palms facing forward (cactus arms). She is barefoot on a grey yoga mat (shoes off for yoga). Front view.
custom-gate-pose-main: Gate yoga pose: kneeling upright on the mat, one leg extended straight out to the side with the foot flat, that hand resting on the straight leg, the other arm reaching up and over the head into a side bend towards the extended leg. She is barefoot on a grey yoga mat (shoes off for yoga). Front view.
custom-revolved-triangle-main: Revolved Triangle (Parivrtta Trikonasana) yoga pose, NOT ordinary Triangle: feet a leg-length apart front to back, both legs straight, hips square to the front of the mat; her torso hinges forward and TWISTS towards the front leg so her chest faces sideways and the back of the shoulders is visible; the hand OPPOSITE the front leg rests on a grey yoga block on the outside of the front foot, and the other arm reaches straight up. She is barefoot on a grey yoga mat (shoes off for yoga). Side three-quarter view.
custom-revolved-side-angle-main: Revolved Side Angle yoga pose: high lunge with the front knee bent over the ankle and back heel lifted, palms pressed together at the chest, torso twisted so the opposite elbow hooks outside the front knee, spine long. She is barefoot on a grey yoga mat (shoes off for yoga). Side three-quarter view.
custom-revolved-half-moon-main: Revolved Half Moon (Parivrtta Ardha Chandrasana) yoga pose, NOT ordinary Half Moon: she balances on her straight LEFT leg, her right leg lifted straight back at hip height parallel to the floor, toes pointing down to the floor; her torso is parallel to the floor and TWISTED so her chest faces sideways towards the camera-right wall with the back of her shoulders visible; her RIGHT hand (the hand opposite the standing leg) is on a grey yoga block under her right shoulder, inside the standing foot, and her LEFT arm reaches straight up to the ceiling. Hips stay square to the floor. She is barefoot on a grey yoga mat (shoes off for yoga). Side three-quarter view from the lifted-leg side.
custom-extended-hand-to-big-toe-main: Extended Hand-to-Big-Toe yoga pose: standing tall on one straight leg, the other leg extended straight forward at about hip height, that hand holding a light-blue strap looped around the lifted foot, the free hand on the hip, pelvis level. She is barefoot on a grey yoga mat (shoes off for yoga). Side view.
custom-upward-salute-main: Upward Salute yoga pose: standing tall with feet together, both arms raised straight overhead with palms facing each other, shoulders relaxed away from the ears, gaze forward. She is barefoot on a grey yoga mat (shoes off for yoga). Front three-quarter view.
custom-staff-pose-main: Staff yoga pose: sitting upright on the mat with both legs together and straight in front, toes pointing up, hands on the floor beside the hips, spine tall, shoulders relaxed. She is barefoot on a grey yoga mat (shoes off for yoga). Side view.
custom-fire-log-pose-main: Fire Log yoga pose: seated upright on the mat, one shin across the front parallel to the mat edge, the other shin stacked directly on top so the ankle rests outside the lower knee, both feet flexed, hands resting on the shins. She is barefoot on a grey yoga mat (shoes off for yoga). Front three-quarter view.
custom-half-lord-of-the-fishes-main: Half Lord of the Fishes yoga pose: seated, one knee bent with that foot tucked beside the opposite hip, the other foot stepped across and flat outside that knee, torso twisted towards the raised knee with the opposite elbow hooked outside it, other hand on the floor behind. She is barefoot on a grey yoga mat (shoes off for yoga). Front three-quarter view.
custom-four-limbed-staff-main: Four-Limbed Staff (Chaturanga) yoga pose: body in a straight plank line hovering low above the mat, elbows bent close to the ribs, upper arms about parallel to the floor, on hands and toes. She is barefoot on a grey yoga mat (shoes off for yoga). Side view.
custom-knees-chest-chin-main: Knees-Chest-Chin yoga pose: knees on the mat, hips lifted up, chest and chin lowered to the mat between the hands, elbows bent close to the body. She is barefoot on a grey yoga mat (shoes off for yoga). Side view.
custom-frog-pose-main: Frog yoga pose: on forearms and knees on the mat, knees spread wide to the sides with shins at right angles to the thighs and ankles in line with the knees, hips eased back, folded towels under the knees. She is barefoot on a grey yoga mat (shoes off for yoga). Rear three-quarter view from slightly above.
custom-reclined-bound-angle-main: Reclined Bound Angle yoga pose: lying on her back on the mat, soles of the feet together, knees falling open to the sides supported by two grey yoga blocks, hands resting on the belly, eyes softly closed. She is barefoot on a grey yoga mat (shoes off for yoga). Side three-quarter view from slightly above.
custom-reclined-hand-to-big-toe-main: Reclined Hand-to-Big-Toe yoga pose: lying on her back, one leg straight on the mat, the other leg raised straight up towards vertical with a light-blue strap looped around that foot, both hands holding the strap, shoulders relaxed on the mat. She is barefoot on a grey yoga mat (shoes off for yoga). Side view.
custom-reclined-hero-main: Reclined Hero yoga pose: sitting between the heels in a kneeling hero position, leaning back onto both forearms, knees together on the mat, chest open. She is barefoot on a grey yoga mat (shoes off for yoga). Side view.
custom-side-crow-main: Side Crow yoga arm balance: hands planted shoulder-width on the mat, elbows bent into a shelf, knees together and both thighs resting on one upper arm, torso twisted to that side, both feet lifted off the mat, a cushion on the mat in front. She is barefoot on a grey yoga mat (shoes off for yoga). Side three-quarter view.
custom-sun-salutation-a-start: Sun Salutation A, first position: standing tall at the front of the mat with both arms raised straight overhead, palms facing each other (Upward Salute). She is barefoot on a grey yoga mat (shoes off for yoga). Side view.
custom-sun-salutation-a-peak: Sun Salutation A, key position: Downward-Facing Dog, hands and feet on the mat, hips lifted high in an inverted V, arms and back long, heels reaching towards the floor. She is barefoot on a grey yoga mat (shoes off for yoga). Side view.
custom-sun-salutation-b-start: Sun Salutation B, first position: Chair Pose, feet together, knees bent, hips back as if sitting on a chair, arms raised overhead in line with the torso. She is barefoot on a grey yoga mat (shoes off for yoga). Side view.
custom-sun-salutation-b-peak: Sun Salutation B, key position: Warrior I, right foot forward with the knee bent over the ankle, back foot flat and turned out 45 degrees, hips facing forward, both arms raised overhead. She is barefoot on a grey yoga mat (shoes off for yoga). Side view.
